entities.summary: Ludwig von Herterich was a German painter and art teacher. He is best known as a painter of portraits and history paintings and is a representative of the Munich School. Ludwig von Herterich was a writers & intellectuals from Ansbach (1856-10-13, Ansbach–1932-12-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
